title: Locate Insecure World-Writable Files
description: Search directory './target_dir' for regular files with permissions 0777 (world-writable) and list their file paths.

title: Find Log Files Modified Within Last 24 Hours
description: Search inside directory './var_logs' for files ending in '.log' that were modified within the last 1 day (24 hours).
hints: Use -mtime -1 to match modification time less than 1 day ago

title: Find SUID Binaries on System
description: Find all regular files in directory './bin_dir' that have the SUID (Set User ID, octal 4000) permission bit set.

title: Find Files Larger Than 10 Megabytes
description: Search directory './data_store' for regular files with size strictly greater than 10 Megabytes (+10M).

title: Redirect stdout and stderr into audit.log
description: Execute script './deploy_check.sh' and redirect BOTH standard output (fd 1) and standard error (fd 2) into 'audit.log' (overwriting).

title: Count Frequency and Sort Top 3
description: Read 'connections.log'. Extract column 1 (IP address), count occurrences of each IP, and display the top 3 most frequent IPs sorted in descending order.
objective: Pipeline: awk '{print $1}' connections.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 3
hints: Command: awk '{print $1}' connections.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 3
solution: awk '{print $1}' connections.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 3

setup_files.connections.log:
10.0.0.1 - ESTABLISHED
192.168.1.5 - ESTABLISHED
10.0.0.1 - ESTABLISHED
10.0.0.1 - TIME_WAIT
172.16.0.4 - ESTABLISHED
192.168.1.5 - ESTABLISHED
10.0.0.1 - ESTABLISHED
10.0.0.2 - CLOSE_WAIT
192.168.1.5 - ESTABLISHED

title: Tee Output to File While Filtering in Pipeline
description: Run the command 'cat events.log', tee the unfiltered output into 'backup_events.log', and pipe the stream through 'grep ERROR'.
objective: cat events.log | tee backup_events.log | grep ERROR
hints: Command: cat events.log | tee backup_events.log | grep ERROR
solution: cat events.log | tee backup_events.log | grep ERROR

setup_files.events.log:
INFO start
ERROR failure
INFO end

title: Sort Numerical Column in Reverse with Delimiter
description: Read 'disk_usage.txt'. Sort by column 2 (size in KB) in reverse numerical order using space as delimiter.

title: Find All Empty Directories
description: Search directory './tree' for directories that contain no files or subdirectories.

title: Skip First Header Line Before Sorting
description: Read 'metrics.csv'. Skip the first header line using 'tail -n +2' and sort the remaining lines numerically by column 2 (-k2 -n -t',').
